headline: Australia Central Bank Lifts Rates to 18-Year High in Split Vote
summary: Australia's central bank raised interest rates to an 18-year high, with a split vote pointing to a potential pause ahead.
why: Central bank policy rate decisions directly influence domestic borrowing costs, currency valuations, and fixed-income yields.

impacts.name: Australia
impacts.why: The central bank lifted interest rates to an 18-year high.
